name: application-range-inputs
title: Range Inputs
description: Range input slider components for volume controls, price filters, and value selectors with custom styling.
useWhen: Range input slider components for volume controls, price filters, and value selectors with custom styling.
avoidWhen: Avoid range inputs when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Range Inputs uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Associate each form field with a visible or programmatic label before production use.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
